reason: An evidence-first DeepSeek Harness workbench for vulnerability research, audit finding management, reproduction, PoC experimentation, evidence tracking, and reporting.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的漏洞研究审计工作台，用于管理发现、证据链、复现流程、PoC 实验和报告准备。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness vulnerability-audit workbench for managing findings, evidence chains, reproduction workflows, PoC experiments, and report preparation.

capabilities: Accesses and updates a configured vulnerability-audit workspace
Provides API endpoints and native tools for findings, evidence, workflows, campaigns, and search
Runs structured reproduction workflows and PoC experiments in Docker isolation
Persists, exports, and synchronizes audit evidence and workspace activity
Can expose unauthenticated mutation endpoints when remote access is enabled
